question: Can complete options pagination restore the evidence path without changing the frozen trading policy?
assumptions: The same pinned paper account remains authorized
The frozen risk and competition policy remain authoritative
A successful read-only data probe does not prove future fills or profit
options: Increase one-page size only (rejected: may still truncate)
Bounded complete pagination with retained rejection gates (selected)

reasons: Current signal is neutral; the controller must not propose an entry.
Signal magnitude is below the frozen entry threshold.

retained_diagnostic_failures: First staged-import harness attempt hit a circular import before any network call; the harness was corrected.
A staged proposal probe hit the expected neutral-direction guard after normalization succeeded; the probe was corrected to treat neutral as abstention. No controller logic was changed.

impact: New-entry evaluations were repeatedly refused on incomplete options metadata. No broker orders, positions, or P&L change were observed through recovery. Forgone trading opportunity cannot be measured from this evidence.
decision: Deploy complete contracts and snapshots pagination; retain all frozen strategy, risk, account, ownership, and time gates.
claim_ceiling: C1 regression mechanics; C2 authenticated current data-path recovery and operational observation; C0 alpha and probability of winning
falsifier: Pagination remains incomplete, any page is silently dropped, strategy/risk/clock hashes change, account identity diverges, journal continuity breaks, or broker state becomes unexplained
cost_risk_budget: No new resources, paid feeds, credential changes, or manual orders. GET-only diagnosis and one named-runner stop/start; hard data bounds: 10 pages, 10000 records, 20-second acceptance budget per options dataset.
stop_rule: Repair verified. Continue the existing hourly monitor and Thursday extras; do not tune thresholds using competition outcomes.
